run_update_schematic: run update_schematic to migrate repeat counts into schematic filters for DIG and BUILD actions in dataset files
run_update_reference_object: run update_reference_object to migrate repeat counts into reference_object filters for DESTROY, SPAWN, BUILD, FILL, GET, SCOUT actions
run_full_data_update: run the script with --input_folder to update all dataset files by moving repeat counts into filter selectors
review_update_schematic: review update_schematic function that transforms repeat fields into schematic filters with return_quantity and same ALLOWED settings
review_update_reference_object: review update_reference_object function that transforms repeat fields into reference_object filters with random_quantity and same DISALLOWED settings
